name: @pipeworx/mcp-openfema

tools.name: disaster_declarations
tools.description: Look up and COUNT US federal disaster declarations (FEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries). Filters: state (2-letter), incidentType (e.g. 'Fire', 'Flood', 'Hurricane', 'Severe Storm'), declarationType ('DR' major disaster, 'EM' emergency, 'FM' fire management), year (fyDeclared, the federal FISCAL year), and since/until for a real calendar date range — use since/until for questions like 'in the past year', which a fiscal year does not answer. Counts are DISTINCT DISASTERS by default, not table rows: FEMA publishes one row per disaster per designated county, so Hurricane Harvey is ~60 rows for Texas but one declaration. Pass designatedArea or grain:'area' for county-level rows. Returns the most recent first. The response echoes `filters_applied` plus a `note`: declarationType/incidentType/state/designatedArea each narrow the total to a SUBSET (e.g. declarationType:'DR' excludes 'EM' and 'FM') — for an across-all-types/all-states total, call again WITHOUT that filter rather than treating one filtered call's total as the grand total; for a true breakdown, call once per value and sum the totals yourself.

year.description: Federal FISCAL year declared (fyDeclared), e.g. 2024. For a calendar window use since/until instead.

since.description: Only declarations on/after this date — ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Use with until for windows like 'the past year'.

until.description: Only declarations on/before this date — ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

designatedArea.description: Filter to a designated area, e.g. 'Harris (County)'. Implies county-level grain.

grain.description: 'disaster' (default) = one record per declaration; 'area' = one record per designated county.

orderby.description: OData $orderby, default 'declarationDate desc'. Live-API path only.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Generic OData query against any OpenFEMA dataset. Specify the entity name (and optionally version; defaults to the verified current version) plus OData params: filter, select, orderby, top, skip. Use list_datasets to see available entities/versions and the filter syntax. Returns { metadata, records }.

version.description: Path version like 'v1'/'v2'/'v4'. Optional — defaults to the verified current version for known entities.

filter.description: OData $filter, e.g. "state eq 'TX' and fyDeclared eq 2023".

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the OpenFEMA datasets this pack knows about, with their entity name, current version, and a description. Also documents the OData filter syntax and response shape. Call this first to discover what query_dataset can target.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openfema forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openfema pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
